title: Turkish-Style Beef Kebabs
description: Tender beef, marinated in a blend of zesty and smoky flavors, grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of flatbread or pita.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most middle eastern stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, spice blend, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix until coated.
Let the beef marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef reaches 160°F (71°C) for medium-rare.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
